# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_FADE_AND_RECLAIM

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price extends >1.5 ATR above the upper EMA ribbon and then closes back inside the ribbon on the same bar, the overextension often reverts, providing a short‑term long opportunity. (Mirror for short side: extends >1.5 ATR below lower EMA ribbon and closes back inside.) This captures intraday mean-reversion from exhaustion moves without waiting for a rejection candle.

## Mechanism

Compute upper EMA (21 EMA) of ribbon; if high > upper EMA + 1.5*ATR(14) and close <= upper EMA, enter long at close. For short: low < lower EMA - 1.5*ATR(14) and close >= lower EMA. Exit: Stop at the extreme of the bar (high for long, low for short); target 1R or exit when price reaches the opposite EMA (lower EMA for long, upper EMA for short). Regime filter: Only trade when VIX < 18 and time is within first two hours after open (09:30-11:30 ET). Avoid periods where ribbon slope is near zero (choppy).
